_doc: What BLIS can and can't represent at the locked binaries. The Nous adapter enforces these and method-plan.md's table is generated from them. `pattern` is matched in full against each knob a request varies (`flag` knobs are BLIS run flags; `epp:` knobs are EndpointPickerConfig parameters set in the scenario). Re-verify with scripts/verify_upstreams.py when the lock changes.

removed.why: the only --pd- flag at the locked binaries is --pd-transfer-contention (fabric contention, inference-sim cmd/root.go:750); the P/D decider is an EPP plugin (prefix-based-pd-decider, always-disagg-pd-decider; sim/llmd/support.go:52-53). Re-add only as that plugin's EPP parameter, verified at the locked binaries.

--block-size-in-tokens was removed in inference-sim #1851 (cmd/docs_examples_test.go:47 removedRunFlags; block size now comes from the scenario); --hash-chain-block-tokens appears nowhere in the BLIS source. Re-add only as the scenario field that carries it, verified at the locked binaries.
